summary.text: Martine Gulick is a Democratic member of the Vermont State Senate for the Chittenden Central District, which she has represented since January 2023, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A Burlington resident, she is an educator who has worked as a high school teacher and library director.

paragraphs.text: Martine Gulick was born in Tachikawa, Japan, and earned a B.A. and M.A. from the University of Vermont.
She was elected to the Burlington School District board, became a regional representative on the Vermont School Board Association, and served on the Advisory Council on Literacy.
